description: This file defines a class 'Table' extending Doctrine's Schema Table, providing methods to set schema manager, add columns, and create the table within a database schema, specific to the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: A class extending Doctrine's Schema Table with added functionality for managing schema and creating tables in the database specific to the application's schema management.

methods.name: setSchemaManager
methods.description: Sets the schema manager used to perform schema operations.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a new column to the table with specified options, returning the table object for chaining.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Executes the SQL command to create the table in the database.
